sources.title: GitHub - qubvel/efficientnet: Implementation of EfficientNet model ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains a Keras (and TensorFlow Keras) reimplementation of EfficientNet, a lightweight convolutional neural network architecture achieving the state-of-the-art accuracy with an order of magnitude fewer parameters and FLOPS, on both ImageNet and five other commonly used transfer learning datasets. The codebase is heavily inspired by the TensorFlow implementation.

sources.title: EfficientNet · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview The EfficientNet model was proposed in EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks by Mingxing Tan and Quoc V. Le. EfficientNets are a family of image classification models, which achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, yet being an order-of-magnitude smaller and faster than previous models.
